description_en: Queries a list of backup logs and returns their download URLs
description_zh: 查询备份日志列表、获取备份日志下载地址
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-backup-logs --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --start-time 2020-02-01T15:00Z --end-time 2020-02-12T15:00Z --backup-region cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupLogs

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需晚于查询开始时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：
30 
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0且不超过Integer的最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

BackupLog.description_en: The details of the backup logs

BackupLogEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup log. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupLogEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份日志结束时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

BackupLogName.description_en: The name of the backup log file

BackupLogSize.description_en: The size of the backup log file, in bytes

BackupLogStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup log. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupLogStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份日志开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

DownloadLink.description_en: The public download URL for the backup log
DownloadLink.description_zh: 备份日志的公网下载链接

IntranetDownloadLink.description_en: The internal download URL for the backup log
IntranetDownloadLink.description_zh: 备份日志的内网下载链接

LinkExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the download URL

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
